intro.title: What's Your Pickleball Level?
intro.lead: Not sure if you're a 2.5 or a 3.5? Whether you're brand new to the game or a seasoned rec player at Lemon Rally Club, knowing your skill level means better matches, better games, and faster improvement. Take our free club assessment and find out in under 3 minutes.

features.title: Your Skill Rating
features.desc: A 1.0–5.0 rating based on USA Pickleball standards.

features.title: Category Breakdown
features.desc: See exactly where you're strong and where to improve.

features.title: Playing Style Profile
features.desc: Banger, dinker, or all-around — find your natural game.

features.title: Club Matching
features.desc: Get matched with Lemon Rally Club players at your level.

faq.q: How accurate is this pickleball skill assessment?
faq.a: Based on USA Pickleball's official skill rating criteria — the same starting point recommended before getting an official DUPR rating.

faq.q: What's the difference between a 3.0 and a 3.5?
faq.a: At 3.0 you're consistent with basic shots and understand positioning. At 3.5 you're developing third-shot drops, sustaining dink rallies, and reading your opponent.

faq.q: Do I need to create an account to take the quiz?
faq.a: No — the quiz is completely free for Lemon Rally Club members. No sign-up required.

faq.q: What is pickleball skill assessment used for?
faq.a: It helps you find the right open play sessions, join the right tournament brackets, and get matched with players who challenge you without overwhelming you.

questions.q: How long have you been playing pickleball?

opts.t: Just started — still learning the rules and basics
A few months — I can keep score and get the ball in play
1–2 years — I play regularly and know my way around the court
3–5 years — I play competitive rec or open play consistently
5+ years — I play in leagues, tournaments, or at a high level

bands.label: 1.0 – Beginner
bands.desc: Just getting started. Focus on keeping it in play and learning the rules.

bands.label: 2.0 – Novice
bands.desc: Building fundamentals. Working on consistency and court position.

bands.label: 2.5 – Developing
bands.desc: Rallying with intention. Starting to understand placement and the soft game.

bands.label: 3.0 – Intermediate
bands.desc: Solid all-around player. Consistent groundstrokes, learning the kitchen game.

bands.label: 3.5 – Strong Intermediate
bands.desc: Reliable technique with growing strategy. Third shot drops becoming a tool.

bands.label: 4.0 – Advanced
bands.desc: Consistent, intentional play. Strong at net, can exploit opponent weaknesses.

bands.label: 4.5+ – Elite
bands.desc: Tournament-level. Full command of pace, spin, placement, and strategy.

1.label: Power Banger
1.desc: You win with pace. Adding a soft game will make you unpredictable.

2.label: Aggressive Driver
2.desc: You like to attack. Mixing in resets will take your game to the next level.

3.label: All-Around Player
3.desc: Versatile and adaptable — the hardest style to play against.

4.label: Soft Game
4.desc: Patient and precise. Sharpening your drive will complete your arsenal.

5.label: Pure Dinker
5.desc: Kitchen is your home. An aggressive third shot drop will open up more points.
